what_happened: Scene L6/S6, the only success of the three L6 episodes. Here the sponge started far left of the sink (not at the basin edge as in s16/s19). Pan (pan_4) grasped by the handle at 127 and placed at 255 (stage 0 at 269). Sponge grasped at 389 and placed in the pan at 515 (stage 1 at 540). Stage 2 took 352 steps. 560-850: the gripper hovered right of the faucet with the small stick lever in the wrist view, without contact. It then pushed the lever from above at 856; success at 892.
self_recovery: none needed; a ~300-step hover near the lever (like s27's) ended in a push.
official_criterion_notes: Unlike s16/s19, the sponge here did not count as in the sink at step 0 (it started 0.21 m from the region).
